question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.**

A group of wolves
solution:
The Correct answer is "**Pack"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of other words.
 
 
• **Pack** :- A group of **wolves** is called as Pack
 
• **Flock** :- A group of **birds** is called as Flock
 
• **Troop **:- A group of **soldiers** is called as Troop.
 
• **Tribe** :- A group of **people** related by blood or marriage is called as Tribe.
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meaning of the given words the correct answer will be "**Pack" **i.e Option no 1.
